purpose: PR 1 deterministic regression smoke set; not performance certification
time_grid: integer timestamps: 1,000,000 + i*5,000 us, i=1..2400; truth is integrated from the preceding interval using midpoint motion, while instantaneous IMU samples use the motion profile at the sample time

evaluation_window.reporting: fixed expected denominator and unavailable/stale counts, plus conditional error metrics over valid outputs

frames_and_conventions.orientation: world_from_body quaternion; q.rotate(body_vector) returns a world vector

scenarios.definition: zero body angular rate and zero world linear acceleration for all t in [0,12]
body angular rate [0.18,0,0] rad/s for 2 <= t < 8 s; zero otherwise; no translation
scenarios.historical_match: transparent recreation; original generator and exact trajectory parameters unavailable

scenarios.definition: zero true rotation; world acceleration [0.2*g,0,0] for 2 <= t < 8 s and zero otherwise; duration 12 s
scenarios.historical_match: matches requested interval and magnitude; exact historical sensor/noise generator unavailable

scenarios.definition: body angular rate [0,0,0.035] rad/s for 2 <= t < 12 s; zero otherwise; no translation

noise_model.initial_sensor_bias: zero; bias random walk enabled only for the corresponding sensor noise mode
noise_model.calibration: identity/uncalibrated; startup gyro-bias calibration is independently declared per run

input_modes.IMU_ONLY: six-axis IMU samples only; no runtime aid or ongoing stationarity hint; startup_knowledge is independently set to UNKNOWN or EXTERNALLY_VERIFIED_STATIC
input_modes.TRUSTED_AIDED: same IMU samples plus an independent synthetic heading-sensor proxy at 1 Hz, sigma 0.04 rad; startup_knowledge remains a separate field

startup_knowledge_window: EXTERNALLY_VERIFIED_STATIC is asserted only while t < 2 s; the assertion is cleared at motion onset

runtime_aid.TRUSTED_AIDED: synthetic independent heading measurement every 1 second from t=2 through t=12 inclusive; measurement = wrapped truth yaw + N(0,0.04 rad), separate PRNG stream, source_id=0x48454144

metrics.tilt_error_deg: acos(dot(q_est.unrotate(world_up), q_truth.unrotate(world_up))) in degrees; invariant to relative left-multiplied world yaw
metrics.yaw_error_deg: wrapped Euler yaw difference, diagnostic only
metrics.p95: nearest lower order statistic at floor(0.95*(n_valid-1))
metrics.nis: reported only when the corresponding gravity update is accepted; heading aid NIS is retained in the per-sample trace with source label

seed_sets.application: for pure_roll, lateral_accel_0p2g and slow_yaw, each of accel_only, gyro_only and combined; static has a deterministic clean reference only

raw_sample_record.layout: little-endian u64 timestamp_us; f32 accel xyz; f32 gyro xyz; f32 independent heading measurement rad; u32 heading-present flag
raw_sample_record.one_stream_per: scenario/noise_mode/split/seed; shared by all estimator and aid configurations

historical_figures: Existing Bundle B CSV/summary artifacts are protocol v1 and are not silently overwritten; see remediation/FAILURE_REPRO.md for metric correction and supersession record.
